solves.reasoning: kindness project → positive letters = cheerful (not gloomy). balcony garden with not much room = limited. Mrs. Pike grateful = brightening spirit
letter inside package = folded. Anna happy about class trip = thrilled. gardening club uses reused containers = recycled
letter ended with hope = concluded. Mrs. Pike made jam herself = homemade. Anna kept writing monthly = continued
Anna was deeply ___ by response → positive emotion after receiving heartfelt letter + jam = moved. unmoved contradicts 'deeply'
Anna ___ the box → she then walked closer and saw address = she saw it first = noticed. overlooked means missed/ignored, contradicts next actions
Whenever Anna looked at rosemary, she had a ___ feeling → positive ending, daily reminder of kindness = warm. cold contradicts the positive tone
Teacher announced village visit to meet seniors Anna wrote to → exciting news = thrilled. Other options are negative emotions
letter concluded by ___ hope → sharing/showing hope = expressing. concealing=hiding, denying=refusing, abandoning=giving up
thanked for brightening her ___ → emotional uplift from kind letters = spirit. appetite/budget/schedule unrelated to emotional brightening
cheerful describes happy, upbeat letters → lively carries similar positive energy. gloomy=opposite, formal=different quality, brief=length not mood
concluded = ended/finished → finalized means completed/wrapped up. launched=started (opposite), expanded=grew, delayed=postponed
commented on how wonderful they smell = made an observation → remarked. complained=negative, whispered=volume, hesitated=paused
forgot = failed to remember → recalled = brought back to memory. Direct antonym pair. ignored=intentional, regretted=emotion, repeated=action
limited = restricted/small → boundless = without limits. restricted/scarce similar to limited. moderate = medium amount, not opposite
(A) planted herbs = put seeds in soil. (1) plant trees = identical meaning. (2) plant evidence = place secretly. (3) plant = factory. (4) plants a kiss = gives a kiss
glass + wide opening + food storage → jar (like jam jar in the story). pot=cooking vessel, vase=flowers, barrel=large wooden container
included ___ (draw) of flowers: need noun after verb 'included', plural because multiple flower drawings → drawings
The letter was ___ (sign): passive voice structure (was + past participle) → signed
despite limited space, she enjoyed ___ → context is about her balcony garden → taking care of her plants. Other options not mentioned in story
Final sentence theme: rosemary reminds her of connection → people need warmth/care like plants need sunlight. Metaphor tying the whole story together
